# Jayden Daniels again delivers in 'high pressure' situation for Commanders

* John Keim Nov 24, 2026, 02:09 AM ET
  
  Close
  
  John Keim covers the Washington Commanders for ESPN.

was a second consecutive game-winning drive, this time resulting in a last-second 27-yard [Drew Stevens](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/5081335/drew-stevens) field goal and [22-20 win](https://www.espn.com/nfl/game/_/gameId/401873078/bengals-commanders) over the [Cincinnati Bengals](https://www.espn.com/nfl/team/_/name/cin/cincinnati-bengals) .

On Monday, he needed only two passes to move the Commanders into field goal position, and both went to rookie [Antonio Williams](https://www.espn.com/nfl/player/_/id/5081432/antonio-williams) : a 22-yarder across the middle and 42-yarder on a deep crosser to the 8-yard line. Daniels finished with 289 yards passing and 55 more rushing. He also led scoring drives on six consecutive possessions, Washington's most in a row

excerpts: Burrow is still Burrow, so he managed 300 yards and two TDs on 28-of-40 passing, but he was constantly thrown off rhythm by Washington’s pass rush.

Starting the final possession with no timeouts, Daniels zipped a 22-yarder to [Antonio Williams](https://www.nfl.com/players/antonio-williams) down the gut of the Bengals defense to reach midfield. After a spike to save clock, Daniels went right back to Williams on a crosser, placing the ball perfectly past [DJ Turner](https://www.nfl.com/players/dj-turner) to the rookie, who broke free deep into enemy territory. Another spike later, and fellow rookie [Drew Stevens](https://www.nfl.com/players/drew-stevens) was lining up to nail his fifth kick of the night, a 26-yard game-winning stunner.

recap.paragraph: Who won the last kick? Drew Stevens did, giving Washington a 22-20 win over Cincinnati! Joe Burrow first zipped a touchdown pass to Tee Higgins for a 10-0 lead. Washington fought back, but Evan McPherson's 56-yard kick put Cincinnati ahead late. Then Jayden Daniels hit Antonio Williams for 2 long passes. Stevens kicked the winning field goal as time ran out. Washington scored on 6 consecutive drives and ended Cincinnati's 5-game winning run.
